rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithm-based rent-setting tools
rules.requirement: Property owners and managers may not use algorithm-based tools that recommend or set rental prices.
rules.quoted_span:
In July 2024, the San Francisco Board of Supervisors approved 
legislation to ban property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend 
or set rental prices.

enacted_date.quoted_span: In July 2024, the San Francisco Board of Supervisors approved

rules.coverage_text: Property owners and managers in San Francisco.

tool_input.notes: The document is a Los Angeles City Council motion. It only asks the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on algorithm-based rent-setting software and on whether a ban would be feasible, so it creates no Los Angeles rule. The only rule recorded is San Francisco's legislation, which the motion mentions in passing. Because it is described in a document from another jurisdiction, it is marked as a secondary source. No citation or exact date is given for it.
